title: Proteostatic remodeling of small heat shock chaperones - crystallins by Ran-binding protein 2 and the peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase and chaperone activities of its cyclophilin domain
authors: Hemangi Patil; Kyoung-in Cho; Paulo A. Ferreira
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Ranbp2的CY结构域对晶状体蛋白稳态的调控，属于蛋白质稳态与神经保护机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Disturbances in phase transitions and intracellular partitions of nucleocytoplasmic shuttling substrates promote protein aggregation - a hallmark of neurodegenerative diseases. The modular Ran-binding protein 2 (Ranbp2) is a cytosolic molecular hub for rate-limiting steps of disassembly and phase transitions of Ran-GTP-bound protein ensembles exiting nuclear pores. Chaperones also play central roles in phase transitions and proteostasis by suppressing protein aggregation. Ranbp2 haploinsufficiency promotes the age-dependent neuroprotection of the chorioretina against photo-oxidative stress by proteostatic regulations of Ranbp2 substrates and by countering the build-up of poly-ubiquitylated substrates. Further, the peptidyl-prolyl cis-trans isomerase (PPIase) and chaperone activities of the cyclophilin domain (CY) of Ranbp2 modulate the proteostasis of selective neuroprotective substrates, such as hnRNPA2B1, STAT3, HDAC4 or L/M-opsin, while promoting a decline of ubiquitylated substrates. However, links between CY PPIase activity on client substrates and its effect(s) on ubiquitylated substrates are unclear. Here, proteomics of genetically modified mice with deficits of Ranbp2 uncovered the regulation of the small heat shock chaperones – crystallins by Ranbp2 in the chorioretina. Loss of CY PPIase of Ranbp2 up-regulates αA-crystallin proteostasis, which is repressed in non-lenticular tissues. Conversely, the αA-crystallin’s substrates, γ-crystallins, are down-regulated by impairment of CY‘s C-terminal chaperone activity. These CY-dependent effects cause the age-dependent decline of ubiquitylated substrates without overt chorioretinal morphological changes. A model emerges whereby the Ranbp2 CY-dependent remodeling of crystallins’ proteostasis subdues molecular aging and preordains chorioretinal neuroprotection by augmenting the chaperone buffering capacity and the decline of ubiquitylated substrates against proteostatic impairments. Further, CY’s moonlighting activity holds pan -therapeutic potential against neurodegeneration.
abstract_zh: 核质穿梭底物的相变和细胞内分区紊乱促进蛋白质聚集——这是神经退行性疾病的标志性特征。模块化Ran结合蛋白2（Ranbp2）是细胞质中的分子枢纽，负责从核孔逸出的Ran-GTP结合蛋白复合物的解聚和相变的限速步骤。分子伴侣在相变和蛋白质稳态中也发挥核心作用，通过抑制蛋白质聚集来维持平衡。Ranbp2单倍剂量不足通过对其底物的蛋白质稳态调控以及对抗多聚泛素化底物的积累，促进脉络膜视网膜对光氧化应激的年龄依赖性神经保护。此外，Ranbp2亲环蛋白结构域（CY）的肽基脯氨酰顺反异构酶（PPIase）和分子伴侣活性调节选择性神经保护底物（如hnRNPA2B1、STAT3、HDAC4或L/M-视蛋白）的蛋白质稳态，同时促进泛素化底物的减少。然而，CY PPIase对客户底物的活性与其对泛素化底物的影响之间的联系尚不清楚。在此，对Ranbp2缺陷的基因修饰小鼠的蛋白质组学分析揭示了Ranbp2在脉络膜视网膜中对小热休克分子伴侣——晶状体蛋白的调控。Ranbp2 CY PPIase的缺失上调αA-晶状体蛋白的蛋白质稳态，而这种稳态在非晶状体组织中受到抑制。相反，αA-晶状体蛋白的底物——γ-晶状体蛋白，则因CY C末端分子伴侣活性受损而下调。这些CY依赖性效应导致泛素化底物的年龄依赖性减少，而无明显的脉络膜视网膜形态学变化。由此浮现一个模型：Ranbp2 CY依赖性重塑晶状体蛋白的蛋白质稳态，通过增强分子伴侣缓冲能力和促进泛素化底物减少以对抗蛋白质稳态损伤，从而延缓分子衰老并预定脉络膜视网膜的神经保护。此外，CY的兼职活性对神经退行性疾病具有泛治疗潜力。
